_comment: The Leaders screen (SCREEN_OFFICERS, 29), work order 167. Everything it draws is placed at the HD image of its native rectangle (ldrgeom, through core/researchnative), so this file carries no geometry: only the markings, one per thing HD does that the original does not, or leaves out, or cannot fill yet. Each is also stated in the module that performs it, in v3_projektstatus.md, and held by a smoke check (tools/smoke_suite/090a..090c).

marks.hd_state: BUILT, NOT ACCEPTED. The live part of work order 167 is parked (doc/briefs/167-parked-for-data.md, item L).
marks._note: Decision 61. The same sentence stands in the module docstring of screens/leaders/screen.py and in v3_projektstatus.md, and a smoke check fails if it leaves either.
marks.omission_outer_frame: OMISSION — the original paints its rails, panels and the pool/dismiss button faces into OFFICER.LBX 0, one 640x480 picture (officer.cpp:648). The work order leaves every outer frame out ('frames come later over the finished structure'), so HD draws on black and puts its own inner boxes where the original's panels are.
marks.deviation_inner_boxes_drawn: DEVIATION — the four leader rows, the view box, the galaxy box, the two strips and hire mode's panel are glass HUD panels drawn in code (work order 174's blocks) where the original has panels painted into OFFICER.LBX 0 and the box art OFFICER.LBX 1 / 2 / 17.
marks.deviation_hd_font: DEVIATION — the original's bitmap fonts 0, 2 and 3 become the HD font, at a size taken from the native line pitch (ldrdraw.NATIVE_TEXT) and shrunk to the original's own width where it would overflow: the original squeezes, HD shrinks.
marks.hd_extension_sprite_scale: HD EXTENSION — portraits, skill icons, stars and ship pictures at an INTEGER magnification (the Fleets rule, decision 28); the popup at the exact HD size of its native rectangle, nearest-neighbour, so every pixel is the original's and the art stays under the fields it belongs to.
marks.deviation_button_words: DEVIATION — without the extracted art a button is its rectangle and a word read off the art (officer.cpp passes an empty help string to every button, so there is none to transcribe).
marks.deviation_hd_skill_help: DEVIATION — a right click on a skill line opens HD's own box with the text the original's TEXTBOX::Text_Box_ would show (officer.cpp:1761-1792, SKILDESC.LBX); the game's box is not opened, because the answer is display-only and fully known to HD.
marks.transcription_hover: TRANSCRIPTION, drawn by HD alone — the leader under the pointer is lit and, in hire mode, priced, as `_officer_scanned` does in the original (officer.cpp:1320-1336, :796-808). The API has no mouse motion, so HD resolves the row itself and sends nothing.
marks.hd_state_engine_without_fix_30: HD STATE — open fix 30 is APPLIED (work order 175, orion2re orionlayer-local cc542e02) and every control is wired. On an engine WITHOUT it the OFFS block is absent: then POOL / DISMISS / PREV / NEXT / the scroll arrows / assigning / the galaxy box and grid send nothing (ldrinput.NO_BLOCK), the view box stays empty, and a popup whose leader the list cannot name shows the game's own pixels. tools/version_check.py names such an engine.
marks.deviation_view_box_glass: DEVIATION — the view box and hire mode's panel no longer wear the original's art (OFFICER.LBX 1, 2, 17): they are glass panels, decision 71's reason for the buttons (work order 175, after Data's screenshot showed them as near-black boxes).
marks.deviation_map_glass: DEVIATION — the galaxy box is a glass panel, not the black the original's stars sit on (work order 175: Data saw a black mini-map).
marks.transcription_pointer: TRANSCRIPTION, drawn by HD alone — the star, stack and big icon under the pointer (the loop's _scanned_* rules, officer.cpp:986-1086) name themselves in the two strips and the star gets its box. The API has no mouse motion, so HD applies the rules itself and sends nothing (ldrmap.scan).
marks.omission_system_pictures: OMISSION — the colony view's system display: the star picture and the orbits are not drawn; HD writes the star's name and draws each planet in orbit order as the colony screens' planet disc with its name. Clicking a planet there is not forwarded (the original answers only when entered from the colony screen, officer.cpp:1080-1085).
marks.omission_map_strip_monsters: OMISSION — the strip under the galaxy box prints a RACE NAME for a monster's stack and for a tagged node (officer.cpp:2115-2131), from _race_names, which is not on the wire: the strip stays empty for those. A player's stack gets the original's paragraph ('%s Fleet: ' and the counts, HESTR 0x131, 0x102-0x107, the hull names and plurals).
marks.deviation_strip_ink: DEVIATION — the fleet strip is written in the rows' ink, not in the owner's player colour ramp (_main_palette_player_colors, officer.cpp:2143-2150), and the star strip likewise; two lines where the text is too long, never cut (strip_ink).
marks.omission_detailed_ship_view: OMISSION — a right click on a big ship icon opens the combat screen's ship view (CMBTDRW1::Detailed_View_Ship_, officer.cpp:1041-1047). HD has no screen for it: the right click is sent to the icon's field and the game's view is the fallback picture.
